hazards.control: Data sheets on site; eye and skin protection at the additive unit; spill kits.

tabs.overview: Gel carries sand; crosslinked gel carries more at high temperature; the breaker returns the fluid to water so the pack cleans up. Too little breaker leaves damage; too much breaks the gel early.
tabs.engineering: Rheology and break tests at bottomhole temperature; pH buffers control the crosslink.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki fracturing fluids and additives (S50), propping agents (S51), API RP 19C (S52), API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), field practice (S9).

name: Gelling agents, crosslinkers, and breakers
function: The polymer (guar or derivatives) that viscosifies the fluid, the crosslinker (borate or metal) that builds a stronger gel, and the breaker (oxidizer or enzyme) that degrades it after placement.
